clusters.title: 38% of servers never start under the fleet harness
clusters.detail:
Most are servers that need credentials or a runtime Sealmark's launch inference does not provide. Sealmark should report the reason as a typed result (needs-credentials, missing-runtime, bad-launch) instead of one opaque start error. Top signatures:
- 165x `could not start or talk to the server: MCP error -#: Connection closed (server s`
- 22x `the server did not answer initialize within # s (--connect-timeout). The first s`
- 1x `could not start or talk to the server: MCP error -#: Not signed in. Run `cso-cli`
- 1x `could not start or talk to the server: MCP error -#: Not signed in. Run `cto-cli`

clusters.title: Grade drops with no server change: 1 server(s) on 1.0.0 to 1.0.1
clusters.detail:
Same server version, newer Sealmark, lower grade. Either a new rule is catching a real problem (add the server to the corpus as a true positive) or a rule regressed (false positive). Decide per server:
- atmy-mcp: B to C
